limitations: Small development set (50 records) used for both GA search and final evaluation — no held-out test set during optimisation. Evaluation noise CV~0.087.
Temperature=1.0 for legal best config is potentially a noise artefact from stochastic evaluation on 50 records. Temperature ablation (Task 1) investigates this.
BM25-only retrieval throughout v1. Dense and hybrid retrieval are not explored. Retrieval recall on General-QA saturates at 0.730 — a BM25 ceiling.
Citation format mismatch on legal data: CUAD answers do not naturally elicit [DOC_N] citation markers, causing CitF1=0.123 despite RetR@5=0.940.
Legal track GA interrupted by SambaNova 20M/day quota exhaustion. Resumed on new account — results valid but infrastructure instability documented.
